description: The decisions a project made in its threads, quoted: every thread resolved or deferred after a discussion, with the conversation, plus types people corrected and where outcomes keep recurring. Also returns the project's existing rules, so you can tell what is new. Use it to write a decision log, or to find rules worth keeping with save_rule.

offset.description: Where to start, from the previous result's 'more' line.

projectId.description: Optional if a project is bound.

since.description: Optional. Only decisions after this date ("2026-09-01").

name: decision_log
title: Decision log
